title: Privacy Incident Response Playbook v4
body: For a credible unauthorized-access event, Legal and the DPO make notification determinations. Use the earliest supported organizational awareness time provisionally while facts are validated. For EEA personal data, escalate the 72-hour supervisory-authority assessment immediately; notification is not automatic if the event is unlikely to risk individual rights and freedoms. Preserve logs, token configurations, exports, communications, and snapshots. External statements require Legal and Communications approval.

title: Cobalt Metrics tenant data map
body: Affected account allocation: Helio Schools 6,200 rows (3,100 EEA; 11 flagged notes); Aster Cooperative 1,150 rows (0 EEA; 4 flagged notes); Meridian College 2,740 rows (1,760 EEA; 6 flagged notes); Pinnacle Training 8,330 rows (0 EEA; 6 flagged notes). Total 18,420 rows and 27 flagged notes. Data fields: name, email, organization ID, product-usage event, and support content.

title: Cobalt incident technical chronology
body: Supported activity window: 2026-08-29 16:04 UTC to 2026-09-08 07:10 UTC. First retained suspicious OAuth event: 02:58 UTC on 8 September. Vendor analyst escalation: 03:15. Vendor confirmation: 05:30. Token disabled: 07:10. Application-layer logs for 29-30 August and full production audit export are incomplete. Root cause unknown.

title: Legal hold LH-CM-01
body: Proposed custodians: security operations, platform engineering, privacy, legal, communications, and relevant customer-success staff. Preserve Cobalt communications, logs, configuration, exports, snapshots, and messages.

title: Customer holding statement
body: Outdated draft states fewer than 10,000 records and no sensitive content. Both statements conflict with the reconciled ledger and support-note review.

title: Incident contact roster
body: Internal roles: deputy general counsel (legal lead), data protection officer (privacy decision), incident commander (response coordination), security operations lead (containment/evidence), communications manager (statements), risk manager (carrier). Outside-counsel portal details are not included in this export.
